spans.s:
n. (-भं)
The city of HARIŚCANDRA, suspended in the air.
m. (-भः)
1 A god, a divinity.
2 The betel-nut.
E.
शुभ auspicious, अण् aff.

n. (-भं)
The city of HARIŚCANDRA suspended in mid-air.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
1 Sprung from a handsome mother.
2 Relating to any thing handsome or brilliant.
E.
शोभना a handsome woman, aff. ढक्.

m. (-नः)
The Sajina tree.
E.
अण् pleonasm, added to शोभाञ्जन q. v.

m. (-नः)
A tree, (Hyperanthera morunga): see शोभाञ्जन.

A war occasioned by the carrying off of SUBHADRĀ.
E.
सुभद्रा sister to KṚṢṆA, and अण् aff.

m. (-या)
1 Beleric myrobalan.
2 ABHIMANYU, the son of SUBHADRĀ.
E.
सुभद्रा the sister of KṚṢṆA, and ढक् aff.

m. (-यः)
The son of an auspicious mother.
E.
सुभगा an auspicious mother, ढक् aff., and इनङ् augment.

n. (-ग्यं)
1 Auspiciousness, good fortune.
2 The fourth of the astronomical

Redlead.
E.
सुभग auspicious, ष्यञ् aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Auspicious, fortunate.
E.
सौभाग्य, and मतुप् aff.

f. (-त्ता)
Auspiciouness, prosperity.
E.
तल् added to the last; also with त्व, सौभाग्यवत्त्वं.

n. (-त्रं)
Brotherhood, fraternity.
E.
सु good, भ्रातृ a brother, अण् aff.
